title: alchemilla arvensis subsp. floribunda
intro: Alchemilla arvensis subsp. floribunda, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species in the family Rosaceae, characterized by its rosettes of rounded, toothed leaves and spikes of small, yellow-green flowers. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe and protect mucous membranes, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include its anti-inflammatory, astringent, and hemostatic properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating menstrual cramps and heavy bleeding. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
